question: When BTC is quiet, does an individual liquid altcoin's volume breakout and immediate successful retest give a tradable continuation?
source: Binance USD-M 1m frozen files, data/research/ma6_knot_1m_20261011/series; native 5m aggregation. BNB, DOGE, SOL, XRP, BTC benchmark only. Entry dates Shanghai 2023-01-01 to end of tape (2026-09-30 UTC).
signal: BTC 5m absolute open-to-close return no larger than its prior 288-bar median. The alt opens at/on the inside of the relevant previous 12-bar boundary, closes beyond it, absolute body return exceeds prior 288-bar median, and volume at least twice prior 12-bar median. Immediate next 5m bar touches the old boundary and closes outside. Both directions.
fills: After confirmed retest, next 5m open. Scheduled exit at either 5 or 15 minutes. Tied clocks sorted by symbol; single occupied slot 15 minutes for both arms. No search, no stop. No global alarm trigger.
control: Same-symbol nonsignal entry in same UTC 4h block and same categorical prior 1h volatility. Same side and duration. Independent comparisons, random seed 20261114.
costs: 5bp per market fill (user OKX schedule for comparison). Binance prices, no extra slippage, spread, funding, or contract rounding. Per-notional returns.
